_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Conversation size, in tokens, at which older history is summarized to save context.
examples: let chats get longer before summarizing

settings.description: How many tokens of the most recent conversation are kept word for word when history is summarized.
examples: keep more recent messages when summarizing
